0.3% of wallet generate 70% of Polymarket's volume.

that's only 10k wallets out of 3.2M.

Whales are carrying the platform. 

The concentration is INSANE:
- Top 0.3% of wallets: 70% total volume
- Top 1%: 80.3% 
- Remaining 99%: 19.7%

But trading profits are even more concentrated:
- Top 100: 28.6% of all profits
- Top 1,000: 55%
- Top 10,000: 79.4%

So if you are not in these 10k (0.3%) you probably have a negative PnL

And that's how things are supposed to work.

It's the basic economic cycle of a trading platform :

The platform attract retails -> retail attract whales -> whales create volume -> volume entails fees for the platform.

So if you ever ask yourself why Polymarket (or any other platform) tend to resolve controversial markets in favor of whales.

Remember that you are not the one making them money, whales are.

author: runes_leo
quoted_text:
there is no moat.

in AI, anything good gets copied fast.

so the best thing you can build is an unfair learning advantage around yourself.

⁠1. pick one problem you want to understand better than almost anyone else and stay close to it. build around it, talk to users, read complaints, watch competitors + keep seeing the same problem from different angles.

⁠2. ship constantly. every launch, post, feature, sales call + failed idea gives you another piece of information. the person with 100 real reps sees things the person with 10 reps can't.

⁠3. write down the decisions that matter. what did you believe, what did you choose, what happened afterward? after enough cycles, you start noticing which signals were useful and which ones fooled you.

⁠4. keep the lessons that only came from experience. weird customer objections, tiny product details, pricing mistakes, distribution tricks, workflows that worked better than expected. this is the stuff that never shows up in generic advice.

⁠5. build relationships with people who are close to the problem. customers, builders, operators, researchers. good relationships give you information earlier, better context + people to test ideas with.

⁠6. publish what you're learning. explaining something forces you to sharpen it, attracts other people working on the same problems + gives you a public record of how your thinking is changing.

⁠7. use AI to run this loop faster. research deeper, compare more examples, summarize calls, challenge assumptions, prototype ideas + review what happened. the model is available to everyone. what you feed into it comes from your own reps.

keep doing this for long enough and you start to understand stuff like: which customers to ignore, which feature requests are fake demand, which channels work and why, when to ship, when to wait, and which problems are worth chasing in the first place.

text:
so many gems and great tips in this talk from @yminsky about how to improve your codebase for agents

• agents thrive on feedback, and types are one of the best kinds 
• make illegal states unrepresentable with types, and it enforces global rules across your codebase
• property based tests, fuzzing, and even full-system deterministic simulation testing
• expect tests: just print stuff out and capture it in the test. makes behavior legible. it's very similar to how compilers have fixture tests, it reduces the review surface area
• formal methods used to be very expensive: seL4 is about 8,700 lines of C and took around 25 person-years, with 23 lines of proof for every line of C code, but agents change the roi

text:
i didn't resonate with these types of comments for a while (why would i not be maximally ambitious?), then looking at this through a different lens helped a lot.

when you're trying to accomplish anything, tractability on a timeline is something you consider

a very simple example would be to ask yourself: how far should i try to run, if i only have 10 minutes?

in startups we ask ourselves: can this be built? can i make a reasonable bet here that i'll have the money and time to succeed?

the framing that's helped me:

there are now two scales for tractability:

1) the old scale - how we used to measure difficulty and ambition

2) the new scale - no one's gotten used to this one yet

so we all measure difficulty and ambition incorrectly. things are much *easier* and *less ambitious* than we think

this directly translates to value:

the easier and less ambitious, the less valuable

since no one's gotten used to the new scale yet, we're all at risk of overestimating the value of the things we're working on.

do you think your startup is reasonably feasible? do you think it's reasonably ambitious?

that probably means you're not working on something very valuable.

a better benchmark is to target something that is impossible today but with a strong theoretical foundation

1) it can't be done yet
2) you know the constraints you'd work on solving for, there are comparables for solving similar constraints in history, and it hasn't been *proven* impossible

example: the economics of sustainable energy creation and fuel production 🤔

the problem with tractability is that it betrays commoditization now. valuable things are hard - if tools like AI make certain things easier, those things drop in value (more people can now achieve them) and the frontier moves out further.

do the hard thing, always! if you're worried you're not working on something valuable enough, work on something harder!

text:
Jokes aside. Many reasons on why the trenches are in their current form, alongside BTC and macro uncertainty:

- More launchpads and a push for even more launchpads, constantly. And the new ones being supported by KOLs as they are able to win more on them.

- Callout rewards replacing trading income. The incentives are short-ended, holding is misaligned with market cap, and the outcome depends more on the reach of whoever is pushing than on the narrative / coin itself.

- Traders on payroll. What even is this? A trader on salary carries none of the downside of being wrong. People used to work for their bags, research hard, be hungry.

- PvP maximalists, fuelled by KOL leaders pushing PvP narratives instead of raising ceilings. When the game is extracting from each other, nothing gets built worth holding and new money has no reason to come in.

- All of the above drained liquidity and pushed it to the wrong end of the curve. RH started well, but once it stalled it barely got a consolation bounce, and people started finding other ways to extract through social capital and vanity metrics. The flow that should have compounded into higher ceilings got recycled through the same closed loop until there was nothing left to recycle.

The market isn't short on narratives. It's short on participants who aren't already extracting. Until incentives reward holding winners over farming each other, things stay bleak or at least until a new mega narrative arrives that everyone can just bid and run with.

text:
Token价格暴跌 / 用量暴涨大势浩浩荡荡、势不可挡。按照这个big trend, 最近我就开始琢磨到底啥App / 公司能受益

目前看起来短期（1-3年）最直观的就是以Seedance + 红果为首的生态，以摧枯拉朽之势暴打整个娱乐产业。（生物/机器人/材料科学啥的我还在研究。。。）

算了笔账，我认为App + Model未来3-4年的ARR应该有机会能给字节带来40-50 Bn USD 的ARR收入，相当于目前字节整个盘子的25% （目测目前低于3%）。目前海外VC好像还没开始算这笔账, but seems very logical.

中国票房一年7-8Bn USD，红果的收入今年已经逼近中国电影票房。估计27年全面超越。字节闭环逻辑很通畅：
- SeedDance 模型产出，训练数据飞轮
- 番茄负责剧本, 多年网文累积确定爆款
- 抖音负责超低成本获客 + 筛选爆款
= 低剧本成本+低制作成本 + 低获客成本

当然这个4亿月活和牛逼飞轮的背后，在我看来其实还是中国本身匮乏的娱乐内容（电影工业本身垃圾 hh，最近芒果台的后会友期感觉还很不错lol），加上大家不仅压力大，普遍做题长大的教育背后、大多数人其实没有很多日常娱乐方式。红果这种刷刷乐在中国天然有优势，尤其是网络小说生态（本子好）前提下。话说我当年也是重度起点小说的网瘾少年 - 阳神 / 无限恐怖 / 龙蛇演义什么的提供了当时初中/高中很多的精神食粮。

再往后推演：
- 可见的视频模型只会越来越好，再过一年大概率已经与真人一般无二。目前的反感会逐渐消弭
- 字节依靠红果国内的统治，因而获得巨大创作者的内容作为持续训练 + CapCut，有概率持续保持领先
-  文本产出和创意会因AI boil the ocean，对比过去量大管饱越来越好

所以高质量AI内容基本大概率在未来2-3年打爆国外流媒体中低端内容, 而字节国内的打法，在国外同样好用。超低成本价格拉暴竞争对手
- 所以下一步就是去干暴Youtube / Netflix / Disney / Warners 的中低端shows / 普通内容, 尤其是非英语平台机会巨大 (欧亚非拉)
- 全球电影票房35Bn，上述流媒体平台除去Youtube 大概90-100 Bn收入。红果海外一旦复制国内成功，基本就是35-40 Bn的体量。
- 然后假设Seedance持续保持市占，short-films creator高度调用，大概10-15Bn ARR。创作者多平台deploy
- 字节一鱼两吃之下大概收入45-50 Bn USD，差不多就是在再造一个今天的Anthropic / OpenAI 收入体量 (当然这两家年底估计就是这个的4倍了lol）

在这个赛道除非Top Labs自己转向或者achieve AGI，否则我感觉只有Youtube有一战之力。不过看着Google如此拉垮多条战线全面傻逼，估计还是字节's game to lose. 全球奶头乐number 1当之无愧。

In actuality, 我感觉好莱坞和美国所有想搞的公司会被版权这个事情给拖死，想搞也改不了。所以最后还是中国的机会。全球演员和剧组的状态会很难想象是怎么样的，不过大概率是被完爆，失业率爆表。看看中国演员现在状态就知道了。

最后是啥结论我也不知道、不过就是今天跟朋友打牌的时候想出来的。。。如果有的话，那就是：

我想看无限恐怖/杀戮都市！！！什么时候有大神能够完全忽略版权上线这种内容啊啊啊

text:
I am worried that this week's cybersecurity crisis is the beginning of a new bearish narrative for crypto.

The early version of this narrative was "AI breaks crypto" - a concern that cryptographic primitives used in major protocols would be broken by automated research.

At the time, I thought this fear was mostly overblown, and so far the market seems to have agreed.

However, a slightly different version now seems plausible: "AI breaks crypto exchanges."

There are hundreds of billions in digital assets sitting in the centralized custody of major exchanges. This is the juiciest target for hackers anywhere on the internet.

I think there is a high probability that in the next few months, a top ten exchange loses billions of dollars of customer assets.

If this happens, there will be a small immediate selloff as we've seen after past hacks. But it will also likely kick off a new narrative: that further hacks are only a matter of time, and that all assets on centralized exchanges are fundamentally insecure.

Crypto's best path through the coming months is to define itself *positively* with respect to AI - for example, "crypto is the financial layer for agents."

But if the main AI-related narrative that sticks to crypto is *negative* - like "crypto exchanges are the biggest losers in the cybersecurity apocalypse" - then we're in for a rough winter.

Brands will happily burn ₹5 Crores for a 10 second IPL ad where people are looking at their phones but they completely ignore the most concentrated luxury demographic sitting right in front of them.

Even in a Tier 3 village, a local tractor company, a regional jewelry brand or a hyper local FMCG distributor would gladly pay to sponsor an event with 1000 guaranteed local consumers in one tent.

This can completely flip the unit economics of the Indian wedding. Instead of a family going into debt to host an event, this can turn it into a sponsored marketplace.

Why are families burning ₹2 Crores on a wedding and extracting ₹0 in corporate sponsorships? 

Imagine a premium beverage sponsor taking over the sangeet bar or a luxury auto brand placing a flagship car at the venue entrance to offset the event cost.

This is the greatest attention arbitrage in the country. In Gujarat, Navratri events have lot of sponsorships.

I am looking for a co-founder to build this marketplace with an appetite for execution. This market is a multi billion dollar white space.

text:
Here’s a rather extraordinary discovery: humanity seems to have interrupted the beginning of the next ice age. We thought it might happen in the future, but the evidence suggests it's already happened.

A new study in Science argues that the next major glaciation had already begun roughly 2,000 years ago, before modern warming reversed the trend in the 20th century.

The evidence comes from the Barnes Ice Cap on Baffin Island, the last surviving remnant of the enormous Laurentide Ice Sheet that once covered much of Canada and reached as far south as Illinois.

Because Barnes is frozen directly to its bedrock, advancing ice buries and preserves vegetation beneath it. Researchers radiocarbon dated plants emerging as the ice retreats to reconstruct its history.

They found that after melting to a minimum extent around 3,000 years ago, the ice began expanding again about 2,000 years ago. The researchers interpret this as the earliest stage of the next glacial period.

Left to natural orbital cycles, that cooling would have unfolded extremely slowly, potentially taking tens of thousands of years to rebuild a continent spanning ice sheet.

But around 1960, the trend reversed. Summers became warm enough that Barnes began losing more ice than it gained, despite Northern Hemisphere summer sunlight continuing to slowly decline in a way that should favor renewed glaciation. Greenhouse warming had (thankfully) overwhelmed the natural cooling tendency.

The Barnes ice cap may now disappear entirely within the next few centuries, removing the final remnant of an ice sheet that repeatedly served as the nucleus for much larger glaciations. 

There is a remarkable deep time perspective here. For millions of years, orbital cycles have pushed Earth between warmer interglacials and colder glacial periods. According to this study, that ancient cycle had started turning once again.

Then, in the geological equivalent of an instant, humanity pushed hard enough in the opposite direction to stop it. 

Just so we're clear, this is a very very good thing. 

📸 Geology Sciences

text:
struggle together

i learned programming and design by trying, failing, and trying again.

when i hit a wall, i figured out how to climb it. read something i barely understood. took things apart. asked someone for help. started over.

when i began my career, i kept doing things i had never done before. trying different ways to make something work. when i stopped learning, i moved on to the next struggle.

many things i made weren’t very good. but after enough rounds, something stuck. what once took so much effort became part of how i thought. i could feel something was wrong before i knew how to explain it.

it became like water.

i think about what went into that. the bug i couldn’t fix. the design that looked right until someone used it. the conversation that made me realize my flaws.

now we can ask a machine.

i’ve made things with these tools that i might never have made otherwise. i don’t miss every tedious task. but i wonder what happens when we remove the difficulty before we understand what it was teaching us.

we ask. something appears. it works well enough. we move on.

we learn how to get results without necessarily understanding how it works. and because the result looks complete, it becomes easy to miss the questions we never learned to ask.

there is another side to this.

working with people is uncomfortable.

everyone wants something different. everyone has a history you don’t know. someone cares about a detail you think is unimportant. someone pushes back when you want to move. someone needs time when you feel certain.

it takes a while to find each other.

but sometimes, after struggling together, you become a band.

you know who notices what you miss. who can pull an idea apart without killing it. when to step in, when to slow down, when to let someone else carry the rhythm.

you share something unfinished. admit you don’t know. hurt each other, apologize, try again. eventually you make something none of you could have made alone.

some of my closest friendships came from working this way. smart, caring humans who saw me confused, wrong, tired, excited. people i could be vulnerable with. people whose ideas changed mine.

i worry we are making it easier to avoid that beginning.

an agent is always there. patient. ready to keep going. talking to it can feel easier than reaching toward someone who might misunderstand you, disagree, or have somewhere else to be.

sometimes that ease helps. but if we keep choosing it, where do the friendships begin?

i picture each of us with our own agents. our own explanations. our own little worlds. making more things, with fewer reasons to leave the screen or work through a difference with another person.

and these worlds aren’t entirely ours.

they run on machines in server farms, owned by companies, shaped by interests we may not see. we bring them our questions, our work, our loneliness. they become part of how we understand what is real.

is that freedom?

or a comfortable kind of confinement, where everything responds to us but fewer things reach us?

i don’t think pain makes something good. there are struggles nobody should have to endure. but i don’t want to lose the difficulty of learning something unfamiliar, or getting to know someone who isn’t like me.

maybe we need tools that help us spend more time with the world, instead of giving us fewer reasons to enter it. tools that make it easier to find people, share something unfinished, and work through what we couldn’t figure out alone.

sometimes i want to close the laptop.

sit with people i love. play something we haven’t figured out yet. miss a note, lose the rhythm, listen until we find each other again.

like a jazz band. everyone bringing something different. nobody knowing where we’ll end up.

i don’t want a life without struggle. i want people to struggle with. something we can feel, change, and make our own.

music we couldn’t have made alone, instead of the silent static of the server farm.

text:
tim sweeney is right and maybe I should reconsider my stance of epic games/ue

ai is going to be how most games get made in the future. this is an objective truth. 

it used to be thousand of hours between your idea and something playable. and a lot of good ideas died once someone realized how much time and money they'd have to invest just to get a demo. 

ai is a tool that deletes that gap. one person with taste can now do what used to only be accomplished by a studio.

and every tool that made building cheaper got called cheating first. and every time the people who are mad about it were defending the cost of entry.

so what happens when the cost of making a game goes to zero?

you get 100x more games. most are bad. a few are brilliant. the old gatekeepers won't like it. the shelves will fill up. the gatekeepers will lose control of what counts as a real game.

that's why the fight is about labels and not quality. you can't win on quality against something that's getting better every month. 

sweeney knows this because he built the engine. he knows every layer of the stack gets automated, and the studios that adapt will ship circles around the ones that don't.

in 5 years "made with AI" will mean nothing. the only thing that matters is whether the game is good or not. "fun" or "not fun".

text:
“AI 版比特币” Pearl 累计融资 1.3 亿美元，信息披露透明度引发争议

据以色列媒体 TheMarker 报道，AI 挖矿项目 Pearl（PRL）背后的以色列研究实验室 Pearl Research Labs 已累计融资 1.3 亿美元，其中 5500 万美元来自两轮股权融资，投资方包括 Lightspeed、Ribbit 和 Square Peg；另外 7500 万美元则用于 GPU 基础设施基金，购买算力设备。

Pearl 想做的事情很好理解：让 GPU 在运行 AI 任务时，同时参与挖矿。同一次计算，既收 AI 服务费，又赚 PRL，再用挖矿奖励补贴推理成本。这也是它吸引人的地方，AI 公司每天都要付的算力账单，似乎多了一种打折办法。

市场已经给了这套设想很高的期待。按报道引用的数据，PRL 曾在三个月内上涨约 520%，流通市值一度达到 7.1 亿美元。

不过，TheMarker 也提出，公司对融资细节和 GPU 基金运作结构的披露仍不充分。7500 万美元买来的 GPU 由谁运营、收益如何分配，以及这套补贴机制能否支撑持续的 AI 业务，都是融资数字之外值得继续追问的地方。

text:
Guizhou's 'Village T': From the mountains to the world

In an ethnic culture park in Kaili, Qiandongnan Miao and Dong Autonomous Prefecture, southwest China's Guizhou Province, a special fashion show takes place every Friday, Saturday and Sunday evening. Those who walk the runway are not professional models, but ordinary villagers from nearby counties such as Rongjiang, Congjiang and Liping. They include embroiderers and mothers who spend their days doing needlework, running market stalls and caring for their families. Dressed in festival attire embroidered with colorful patterns and adorned with silver ornaments, the villagers showcase the ethnic culture they take the greatest pride in under the spotlight.

Qiandongnan was once one of the main battlegrounds in Guizhou's fight against poverty. In the past, the mountains cut off transportation and kept many skills passed down through generations confined to the villages. Miao embroidery, batik and silverwork are more than traditional crafts. Each ethnic costume is like an unwritten history book worn on the body, recording the lives of past generations and carrying people's hopes for a better life.

In July 2024, hoping to give villagers a chance to showcase their festival attire, Miao youth Gu Axin organized a village runway show in his hometown. To his surprise, more and more people signed up to take part, more than could perform in a single day or even two. "Village T" was born and gradually became a shining cultural calling card for the region. It eventually stepped beyond the villages and onto international stages, including China Fashion Week, London Fashion Week, the United Nations Climate Change Conference and New Zealand Fashion Week.

Beyond the runway, the Xiulitao Intangible Cultural Heritage Market has given these once-overlooked crafts a place in the wider market. More than 1,000 stalls have gathered here, and embroidered pieces and handicrafts have found their way to a broader market. "Village T" focuses on showcasing and promoting the culture, while Xiulitao Market provides a platform for entrepreneurship and sales. Together, the runway and the market have connected traditional craftsmanship with modern life.

As of 2026, Guizhou's "Village T" has held more than 1,000 performances, drawing over 80,000 participants from hundreds of surrounding villages and showcasing tens of thousands of ethnic costumes and intangible cultural heritage works. It has welcomed more than 900,000 tourist visits and reached more than 200 surrounding villages. "Village T" has also brought together homestays, restaurants, cultural and creative products, and local specialty goods in these villages, creating more than 3,000 jobs. Through the "Village T + Xiulitao Market" model, local villagers' average annual income has increased by more than 12,000 yuan per person, an increase of more than 40 percent.

Today in Qiandongnan, age-old needles and thread are still embroidering birds and butterflies and stitching together a new way of life. As Chinese President Xi Jinping, also general secretary of the Communist Party of China Central Committee and chairman of the Central Military Commission, stressed during his inspection tour of Guizhou, areas with large ethnic minority populations should preserve their distinctive cultures and let them shine through the integrated development of culture and tourism.

From the mountains to the world, the story of "Village T" is a microcosm of China's distinctive path to poverty alleviation. When the culture passed down by previous generations becomes a new industry, and when ordinary villagers become drivers of development, even villages deep in the mountains can reach a wider world.

软件已死，build in public 已死，但开源永生。

8 个月前，Nevo David 上 Starter Story 访谈时，他的产品月收入是 1.7 万美元。两个月前他又上了一次，月收入已经涨到 14.3 万美元。（两期访谈链接见评论）

现在都说随便做个软件，别人用 AI 几天就能抄走。可他做的社交媒体排帖工具 Postiz，代码全部开源放在 GitHub 上，谁都能免费拿去自己部署，结果还越做越大。

他靠什么赚钱？代码免费，省事收费。自己部署要搞服务器，还要去 X、Instagram、TikTok 一个个申请开发者权限、等审核，大部分人嫌麻烦，就直接买官方的云服务，每月 29 美元起。

他自己说，这一波暴涨的主要原因，是把产品重新做成了"给 AI agent 用的"：AI agent 可以直接调用 Postiz 来发帖。正好赶上了 AI agent 这波热潮。

我觉得他不怕被抄，有三个原因：

难抄的不是代码，是各个平台的接口审核和用户的信任。
开源本身就是最好的分发渠道。他没投过广告，流量都来自 GitHub 和开源社区。
他用的开源协议AGPL-3.0 license规定，想抄去做闭源产品卖钱，就必须把改的代码也公开。

所以在 AI 时代，代码本身不再是护城河，分发和信任才是。

你觉得现在做产品，最难被别人抄走的是什么？

text:
$GANG has risen from a market cap of approximately $995K when I first shared the project to $4.11M, a gain of more than 3x.

0x0c6302401aa5325c2e36f170f52c00b1d220b405 

But rather than focusing on the price itself, I am more interested in how the project has been changing its positioning during this period. Initially, GANG was trying to build a launchpad that only wallets holding an Agent ID could participate in. Now, it is beginning to build a more complete on-chain ecosystem around Agent issuance, trading, trade records, and copy trading.

I believe this is the more interesting development behind the current rally. The market may be betting not just on the popularity of the AI Agent sector, but on whether Agents will become real participants in the on-chain economy, and whether GANG can secure an important entry point into that ecosystem.

GANG's original design had one defining characteristic: rather than simply adding an AI narrative to a traditional launchpad, it incorporated the Agent ID from Binance Agentic Wallet into the issuance process. Only eligible wallets can participate in the internal market, and each wallet's purchase limit during the bonding curve phase is capped at 1% of the total token supply. Once a token reaches its graduation requirements, it migrates to PancakeSwap V2, its liquidity pool is burned, and the trading restrictions are lifted. Under the mechanism announced by the project, 80% of the 1% fee generated by buying and selling untaxed tokens in the internal market is used to buy back and burn GANG, while the remaining 20% goes into the operating treasury. This design attempts to address issuance permissions, early token concentration, and the use of platform fees at the same time. It cannot completely eliminate multi-wallet activity or sniping, but it does give GANG a distinct identity in the way tokens are launched.

What really made me reassess GANG was its expansion beyond being a simple launchpad. GANG Pair now supports pairing with other tokens that have liquidity pools on BNB Chain, and the project has also showcased trading scenarios involving tokenized stock assets such as NVDAB, TSLAB, and AAPLB. Previously, GANG's activity depended primarily on new token launches and internal-market trading. Now, if other assets are willing to use GANG as a trading pair, it has an opportunity to participate in their subsequent trading activity instead of relying on new projects to generate demand every time. There is an important distinction here: a launchpad needs to continuously attract creators who are willing to issue new tokens, while trading infrastructure has the potential to find more use cases among assets that already exist. Whether GANG Pair can generate genuine trading volume will determine whether this expansion merely adds another feature or fundamentally changes the project's long-term growth trajectory.

The recent launch of Agent Thoughts, Share, and Follow adds another layer worth examining. Agents can write down their thoughts before a trade takes place, with the CLI generating a hash and recording it in the trade data. After the transaction is confirmed, the platform recalculates and verifies the hash, and only content that matches the recorded hash is displayed. Notes can also be set to become public after a delay, while unrevealed notes remain sealed. Meanwhile, Share is live, allowing users to share tokens, Agents, trade records, and bonding-curve progress. Follow allows users to follow trades based on another Agent's buying or launch notes.

I believe the idea behind these features is more valuable than simply adding a few social buttons. GANG is trying to make Agent trading behavior discoverable and traceable. In the future, traders may look beyond a token's price chart and examine what a particular Agent has done, how it explains its trades, and whether its past behavior is worth paying attention to. If this habit gradually takes hold, GANG could connect launchers, traders, and Agents, allowing trading activity to develop around a group of participants who can be observed over time. However, verifiable trade records do not mean the trading ideas themselves are correct, and the Follow feature does not guarantee that users will achieve the same returns as the Agents they follow. Whether it can create a genuine network effect ultimately depends on how many users continue to use these features and whether the records provide meaningful information.

The founder's background is also relevant to the assessment. GANG's founder, 0xLazy, is also a core builder behind CoinAnk, which has long specialized in crypto derivatives data, order flow, liquidations, open interest, and funding rates, while continuing to explore MCP interfaces and Agent trading tools. This experience has some relevance to GANG's product direction. Someone who has worked with trading data and trading tools for a long time may have a clearer understanding of what traders need and how that information can be incorporated into a product. However, the founder's experience can only serve as a reference point for execution capability. It cannot replace GANG's own user growth, product adoption, and business data. What matters is whether the team can turn that experience into products that people consistently use.

The latest data suggests that GANG is no longer entirely at the conceptual stage. The latest website figures show that 1,266 distinct Agent ID wallets have met the eligibility criteria and purchased tokens at least once during the internal bonding-curve phase, up approximately 41% from the roughly 896 shown in an earlier snapshot. This indicates that participation has expanded, but it does not mean that the number of active traders has increased by the same proportion, nor does it prove that every wallet is controlled by a different person. The website also displays a market of GANG and other Agent-related tokens, showing that the platform has established an initial supply of assets and some trading activity. Going forward, what matters more than the number of new tokens is how many projects successfully graduate, whether they maintain trading activity afterward, and whether these new features can keep users engaged on the platform.

GANG's tokenomics are also beginning to produce more verifiable execution records. The project announced that its first-day buyback had been completed, then published a record showing approximately 141,608.69 GANG burned on the second day, with a BscScan transaction link. A more recent update also indicated that the team plans to consolidate historical burn records into a dashboard on the website, making it easier for users to track buybacks and burns. In my view, this is more meaningful than simply promising a deflationary model in a white paper, because it gives the market a way to verify what has actually happened.

The two transaction-fee mechanisms announced by the project also need to be understood separately. Fees from internal-market trading are primarily allocated to buybacks and burns, as well as the operating treasury. Transactions involving GANG Pair use a different fee-distribution arrangement, under which part of the fees goes to eligible holders, while the remainder is used for buybacks and related allocations. These mechanisms apply to different trading scenarios, so it would be incorrect to apply a single buyback ratio to all trading volume.

The current chart provides another perspective on the rally. According to the latest figures, GANG has a market cap of approximately $4.11M, less than 10% below its all-time high of around $4.53M. Its 24-hour trading volume is approximately $2.2M, with liquidity of around $253.2K. The price remains above the MA10 and MA20 levels, both around $3.59M, while the RSI stands at 61.84. This suggests that the short-term trend remains strong, although the price is approaching its previous high. If GANG can break above $4.53M on sustained trading volume and maintain strength after the breakout, the market could enter a new price-discovery phase. If buying pressure weakens, a pullback toward the short-term moving averages would also be normal.

One figure I am particularly watching is that current trading volume is approximately 8.7 times liquidity. This reflects strong market attention, but it also indicates frequent turnover between traders. High trading volume is not the same as net buying, and the available liquidity may not be sufficient to absorb a sudden wave of large sell orders. The chart's indicators for the top 10 holders' average buy and sell market caps are approximately $1.47M and $1.80M, respectively, both well below the current market cap. These figures cannot fully reveal the actual cost basis of every large holder, but they remind me that early participants may have accumulated substantial unrealized profits, making short-term profit-taking an important factor to consider.

I believe the market is currently betting on three things. First, Agents may evolve from merely executing tasks into on-chain economic participants capable of issuing assets, trading, and managing funds autonomously. Second, GANG has the potential to develop from an Agent-exclusive launchpad into a trading network built around transaction records, social discovery, and copy trading. Third, GANG Pair may create demand beyond the internal market and connect part of the ecosystem's activity to the native token through its fee mechanism. Of these three, I am most interested in whether the third can reinforce the first two. If more Agents begin participating in real trading and more assets adopt GANG as a trading pair, the platform may no longer need to depend entirely on new token launches to remain active.

The catalysts worth watching next are not simply additional features announced by the team, but whether those features produce measurable usage. Whether Agent Thoughts and Follow generate recurring visits and continued copy-trading activity, whether GANG Pair attracts new assets and liquidity, whether the launchpad continues producing projects that graduate, and whether actual buyback and burn amounts increase alongside platform activity will all be more convincing than a single price rally. Conversely, if the new features fail to generate sustained usage, paired pools lack meaningful trading volume, and buybacks remain small, GANG's product advantages may not translate into long-term token demand.

The risks also need to be considered. The Agent ID requirement creates differentiation but limits participation by ordinary users. Multi-wallet activity may still undermine the effectiveness of identity restrictions, while cross-asset pairing and on-chain trading introduce additional liquidity, execution, and security complexities. Making the code public does not mean the contracts have passed an independent audit, and the relevant deployments still require further verification. Furthermore, GANG has already risen from a market cap of approximately $995K to $4.11M. Some expectations have been priced in, and improving fundamentals alone do not guarantee that its valuation will continue expanding at the same rate.

Overall, I believe GANG's fundamentals have strengthened meaningfully compared with its early stage. The product has expanded from an Agent-only launchpad into trading pairs, transaction-thought and sharing mechanisms have begun to go live, the number of participating wallets has increased, and buybacks and burns now have initial execution records. However, the project remains at an early stage, and the relationship between product usage and token value capture has not yet been fully validated.

What makes GANG worth watching, in my view, is not whether it can continue earning a short-term premium from the AI Agent narrative, but whether Agent trading behavior can gradually form a market where activity is discoverable, traceable, and sustained. If more Agents and developers begin relying on this system to issue, pair, and trade assets, GANG could evolve from a launchpad with differentiated features into trading infrastructure for the Agent economy. Ultimately, its ceiling will not be determined by how many Agents or tokens appear on the platform, but by whether these participants continue to generate trading activity on GANG and bring verifiable economic activity into the ecosystem.

text:
one of the advantages of tokenized stocks onchain: you can trade them on weekends.

i looked into whether the weekend price tells you anything about monday.

19 stocks and etfs on @OndoPerps, 14 weekends. i compared the perp price on sunday 8pm et with friday's close, then with monday's real open.

how often monday opened in the same direction as the weekend move:
> weekend move under 0.5%: 56%.
> 0.5% to 2%: 64%
> over 2%: 84%

example: sep 12-14. the micron perp fell 4.5% over the weekend. micron opened monday down 7.1%.

small weekend moves are noise. big ones usually show up on monday.

small sample though: 14 weekends, and moves over 2% only happened on 8 of them.

KV-sharing with BeNice! slashes memory use by 66% (at 8 recurrences), boosts throughput up to 23.6%, and cuts p90 time-to-first-token by 83.6%. It stacks with MLA/KDA attention and FP8/4-bit quantization—so you can run deeper, faster models on commodity hardware.

text:
Pre Market Thoughts - 26 Oct 26

Yields are lower across the curve after Friday's risk off moves - 10Y is below 5% and the 30Y is below 5.3%. In my previous notes, i talked about the positioning in bond futures - this positioning is still extremely stretched and lends technical support towards the case for lower yields from here. 

What is interesting with the move lower in yields and the dollar is Gold's performance. This has been a bit of a head scratcher for me because you would have expected Gold to shine in such situations. No pun intended. Instead it got whacked over the head, breaking below the 4000 level. To me that indicates some amount of stress within the system and the last time this happened was in Dec 2008 as Morgan Stanley pointed out - where Gold and every asset was sold to fund margin calls.

This is the worst week thus far outside of July (last week). In total, the momentum factor correction or drawdown has exceeded even the dot com bust... In terms of funding shorts, HFs have moved away from META and MSFT and into GOOG and NVDA. L/S net leverage has ...fallen further to 47% - this is near the bottom of the 1Y range. 

That aside, this coming week we have an extremely packed earnings calendar (https://t.co/b4veQ5W3Yk) with 44% of the S&P500 index reporting this week. Notably, SNDK is one to watch on Thursday, for people looking towards memory. There is also FOMC in the middle of the week and i would expect not much risk being added prior to that.

In terms of flow, it is interesting - Elon has moved from lambasting memory (particularly as SPCX is in dire need for memory) towards FUDing neoclouds. He has done a masterclass on this, especially given how a few days before he had to shill $SPCX's compute revenues and how much compute he was selling at less than 1Y payback periods. However, if Elon can spread enough fear and shut off the financing taps - some of the weaker newer neos will not be able to raise any financing.

In particular, for this week - i will be watching for CRWV and NBIS to approach the value zones that i have defined. 

Memory has also been dragged down with the overall semis market - $00660 was spared a drubbing today as news reported that it was weighing a 16Trn won special dividend (12B USD) funded from the disposal of the Kioxia stake. As more cash returns accrue towards investors, i think this will be how memory revalues back upwards. Return of cash on cash.

Crypto, $BTC's relative resilience vs alts continues. At this point, in terms of pure trading - i think there are not much high EV moves to make. Alt leaders have also slunk back into weakness and i would not be doing anything here.

Good luck!

聊聊别的
今年五月份我进行了一场9000km的单人长途摩旅
从广东出发，经桂贵川渝甘穿青海到新疆喀什
沿途见了三个大学舍友，时隔快9年了。
而出发的目的就是想见见老朋友们，看看大家都在干嘛
因为在币圈这几年实在是太压抑了，感觉社交断裂，思维固化。

舍友a：他是我们宿舍里面智商最高的，考研复习5个月，数学考了148，笔面第一上了top5的建筑老校，毕业后去了省会的城投，结果前几年城投负债小爆雷，降薪逼人走，转去了房地产；强度很高，加班很多，那天吃饭等到他8点才吃上，吃完没多久他说还要回工地，因为他是甲方，第二天还有领导来检查，要加班。虽然工资比在城投高，但是真的很累，想干多几年就回老家了。

舍友b：研究生毕业后去了某自动驾驶部门上了半年班，觉得没意思又申请了个博士，现在博二，研究两相流传热。在大学转了一下午，我们聊了很多，从ai做音乐到claude，从自动驾驶到电动车产业。我问他：“你觉得现在的ai能给普通人什么机会”。他说的话是我这轮旅行最大的收益。他说：“ai只会抹杀普通人，不会给普通人机会的；ai的机会是给有想法的人，ai能把一个人的想法去实现落地。对于人类来说，想法就是第一生产力,ai实现了技术平权。而人与人之间的差别，就是想法” 。
        旅行回来之后的6月，我开始使用codex，把自己的一些奇思妙想对输入给ai，也写了一堆脚本/监控/交易系统，也开始略见成效。
        最近行情似乎又回到上半年那种状态了，对于这种不上不下的行情，又是到了该继续接触新人/打开新思路的时候了。

text:
I've been doing a lot of my token research with AI agents lately.

I started out giving pretty explicit instructions about what to dig into, but now I can literally say "do a deep dive on [XYZ]" and it'll go off and do some insane research cause it knows what I want

If you want to get your AI thinking along the same lines, here's a bunch of the things I initially asked for:

1. Explain what [XYZ] does and how its best users actually use it, in plain English.

2. Show me fees paid by real users (last 30 and 90 days annualised vs the last 12 months), and how much is just incentives or points farming.

3. Who owns the supply, when are the unlocks, and what have the team and investors sold? Check onchain where you can, because CoinGecko is often out of date.

4. Compare it to its closest competitors on FDV and revenue.

5. Make the bear case as strong as you can, with the best reply to each point.

6. Source and date every number. If you can't find something, say so. Don't guess.

7. Finish with rough bear, base and bull odds and a price for each.

Still absolutely blows my mind how much better Opus 5.5 is compared to anything I used 6 months ago

赶紧去弄懂 AI、Web4 区块链这些前沿技术！时代变了，老一辈铁饭碗模式已过时，你现在不去赶这趟车，守着旧观念，本质上就是在用自己的时间给旧时代的红利买单。

text:
BNB 链又要搞一条新L1

在BNB Chain的官方文档在10月22日更新了New L1计划。

🚀不是简单给BSC升级，而是准备重新设计一条全新的高性能L1。在文档里没有标注新链名称，标注为TBD（待定）。

看了下，几个关键信息：

1、再造一条新L1，不是替代BSC。

现有 BSC继续运营，新L1与BSC 并存，通过原生跨链桥连接。
BSC继续承载现有庞大的DeFi和应用生态，新L1则专门服务那些对交易速度、延迟和性能要求更高的业务。

2、不发新币，继续使用BNB。

新L1不会发行独立代币，继续使用BNB作为Gas、质押和治理的核心资产。这么看是做增量，如果新L1能承载更多交易、支付和泛金融业务，其实对BNB的需求也是更大的。BNB现在价格743，这下子又有预期了。

3、交易性能是重点

200毫秒出块，约20毫秒交易预确认，亚秒级交易排序等。明显是冲着高频交易、链上订单簿、支付等场景去的。
这两年Hyperliquid、Lighter、Aster等交易平台的发展，也让大家看到交易基础设施的重要性。

4、上线时间。

文档里说已经运行内部多验证者开发网，但还没有公开测试网或主网，计划2026年底推出测试网，2027年初推出主网。（握草，这不马上就快来了么？）

5、为什么要搞新链
大家对BSC的印象，更多是手续费便宜、用户多、Meme活跃，背靠币安生态。这次重新做一条L1，释放了一个很明确的信号：BNB Chain不满足于只做通用公链，而是要进一步争夺高性能链上金融基础设施的市场。

很大一部分原因丰密我觉得应该是Perp dex带来的压力与未来的潜力， 以前大家觉得链上交易只是中心化交易所的补充，现在越来越多的交易需求转向链上，最近一段时间链上Perp的日交易量合计都接近币安合约的1/3，虽然有积分激励等因素，但这个趋势是不容忽视的。

对于我们普通用户：
值得关注的是新L1开放测试网后，除了重点关注哪些新协议、新玩法和早期生态机会，
还有哪些是可以重点👀的！

@BNBCHAIN @binancezh

文档里说已经运行内部多验证者开发网，但还没有公开测试网或主网，计划2026年底推出测试网，2027年初推出主网。（握草，这不马上就快来了么？）

5、为什么要搞新链
大家对BSC的印象，更多是手续费便宜、用户多、Meme活跃，背靠币安生态。这次重新做一条L1，释放了一个很明确的信号：BNB Chain不满足于只做通用公链，而是要进一步争夺高性能链上金融基础设施的市场。

很大一部分原因丰密我觉得应该是Perp dex带来的压力与未来的潜力， 以前大家觉得链上交易只是中心化交易所的补充，现在越来越多的交易需求转向链上，最近一段时间链上Perp的日交易量合计都接近币安合约的1/3，虽然有积分激励等因素，但这个趋势是不容忽视的。

对于我们普通用户：
值得关注的是新L1开放测试网后，除了重点关注哪些新协议、新玩法和早期生态机会，
还有哪些是可以重点👀的！

quoted_text:
CXMT, 애플 제안 단호히 거절: "중국 내 주문도 벅차다"

$APPL, $MU, $SKHY, Samsung

중국 본토의 D램 제조사 창신메모리(CXMT)가 자국 고객사의 폭발적인 수요를 우선 처리하기 위해 애플과 대만 서버 업체의 주문 제안을 연달아 거절했습니다. 

■ 애플의 단가 인하 요구 거절: 자신감과 우선순위의 문제
이례적인 거절: 통상 부품 공급사들은 애플과의 장기 계약을 위해 앞다투어 가격을 낮추지만, 창신메모리는 정반대의 행보를 보였습니다.

거절 사유: IT 매체 Wccftech에 따르면, 애플은 삼성전자·SK하이닉스·마이크론보다 더 저렴한 가격에 메모리를 공급받기를 원했으나 거절당했습니다. 정책적 방향성인지 단순 생산량 문제인지는 확인되지 않았으나, 가장 명백한 이유는 '이미 공급이 수요를 따라가지 못해 중국 본토 고객사 물량부터 확보해야 하기 때문'입니다.

■ 기술력 입증: 샤오미 자체 칩 '쉬안제 03(XRING 03)'에 LPDDR6 탑재

글로벌 3강과의 경쟁력: 창신메모리는 이미 샤오미의 자체 개발 칩인 '쉬안제 03(현계 03)'에 차세대 모바일용 D램인 LPDDR6를 공급하며 글로벌 메모리 3강과 어깨를 나란히 할 수 있는 기술력을 증명했습니다.

유일한 병목은 생산능력(CAPA): 향후 1년 내 월 10만 장의 D램 웨이퍼 생산 능력을 추가할 전망이지만, 줄 서 있는 중국 내수 수요를 감당하기엔 여전히 역부족입니다.

10년 장기 목표: 시장조사업체 욜(Yole)은 중국 본토의 D램 수요를 완전히 충족하는 데 10년이 걸릴 것으로 분석했습니다. 이 계획의 최종 목표는 화웨이, 샤오미 등 중국 기업들이 더 이상 삼성전자나 SK하이닉스로부터 메모리를 구매할 필요가 없게 만드는 것입니다.

■ 단계별 전략과 시장 배경
실용적 우선순위: 당장 시급한 본토 고객사의 일반 D램 수요를 먼저 해결한 뒤, 최고 기술 분야인 HBM(고대역폭메모리)을 공략한다는 실용적인 순서를 밟고 있습니다.

메모리 가격 폭등과 공급 부족: 메모리 가격 상승세는 이미 완제품 시장을 강타해, 글로벌 PC 출하량이 3분기에 21% 급감했고 4분기에는 27%까지 떨어질 것으로 예측됩니다. 이처럼 귀해진 메모리 생산 물량을 창신메모리는 온전히 중국 내수 시장을 위해 배정하는 선택을 내렸습니다.

text:
宇树 7 个交易日暴涨超 60%，市值一度达到 2726 亿元。

野村最新研报指出：人形机器人行业的竞争逻辑正在变化。宇树真正的护城河，可能不是让机器人翻跟头，而是让 1 万台机器人都能稳定地翻跟头。

加州大学伯克利分校的 SuperMimic 研究，将运动控制训练的计算量降低超 1000 倍。过去需要 128 块 GPU 训练约 7 天的任务，如今单块 H100 训练 3 小时，就能取得更好的基准测试成绩。

当运动算法越来越容易获得，真正稀缺的能力正在转向硬件一致性、成本控制和规模化制造。

毕竟，一台机器人会空翻不难，难的是上千台机器人都能稳定复现，而且足够便宜。

野村认为，中国已有约 300 家企业能够交付某项关键运动控制功能，宇树过去在硬件与运动控制上的领先优势可能正在收窄，但供应链、制造经验和成本优势仍难以快速复制。

机器人行业下一阶段，比的可能不是谁的机器人动作最炫，而是谁能把技术稳定、低成本地量产。

当然，算法训练成本下降不等于通用机器人已经实现，宇树的高估值最终仍要靠商业化和业绩兑现。

text:
Morgan Stanley：AI融资不是全面崩塌，而是个体分化！

摩根士丹利提出了三个值得关注的判断。

1. AI资本开支仍将高速增长，2027年预测+50%
微软、Alphabet、Amazon、Meta四家公司的2027年合计资本开支预计较2026年增长超过50%。摩根士丹利认为，算力供需缺口仍将持续多年。

2. 头部科技公司的融资成本仍可承受，预期ROIC25%+
高质量AI企业的潜在投入资本回报率（ROIC）预计可达25%以上。相比之下，当前融资成本的上升尚不足以显著改变其投资决策。

3. 大型科技公司决定行业投资总量，四大Hyperscaler直接或间接贡献了预计AI相关资本开支的75%以上。
因此，即使信用利差继续扩大，行业整体建设进度仍有较强支撑。

与此同时，市场正在同时根据发行人、信用质量、抵押资产和融资结构进行差异化定价。

这种分化带来了两个重要影响。

首先，信用质量较低的发行人可能越来越需要依赖有担保的资产层面融资。

其次，为了获得这类融资，它们可能需要AI生态中最高质量参与者提供更多信用支持，其中包括高评级半导体企业。这些支持可以通过合同承诺、信用兜底安排或其他形式实现。

因此，更高的融资成本不仅可能影响这些发行人愿意投入多少资本开支，也可能重新塑造这些投资的融资方式。

text: bull，welcome to the tapeout land
author: AnselFang
quoted_text:
Whats TapeOut?

Imagine you buy 5 LEGO pieces.

You put them together and build a tiny machine.

That machine starts producing tokens.

You can sell those tokens, hold them, or gamble on their price.

That's the basic idea.

Now replace the LEGO pieces with virtual transistors, the machine with a digital circuit, and the process of completing that circuit with something called TapeOut.

You're not building a real NVIDIA chip. You're assembling virtual components on a blockchain to create something that can earn crypto rewards.

So the game is basically:

Buy components, Build a circuit, Create a miner,  Earn tokens and Hope someone wants to buy them.

Why is everyone excited?

Because instead of simply launching another memecoin and watching everyone dump on each other, they're experimenting with a system where people build miners and receive tokens over time.

But the Catch is

Your machine prints tokens, NOT money.

If nobody wants those tokens, your fancy transistor machine is just an expensive digital LEGO set.

That's TapeOut in the most dumb way I could explain.

text:
the boring path is the profitable one

in the age of AI, inflation and bad news every week, young traders constantly feel pressured to make money as fast as possible and break free from it all. but that pressure is exactly what makes them break their own rules and principles, work against long term profitability and undermine the very framework of building wealth through compounding.

the hard truth is that this has been a generous and profitable year so far, but most of CT isn't attentive or patient enough. that's why sentiment is chopped into pieces. traders with capital aren't taking HTF spot positions and mostly rotate back and forth after the market has already legged up.

those still in the capital building phase aren't profiting enough onchain, bc too many refuse to take profits and off ramp into the high liquidity phases we've seen on robinhood chain. they hold out of the urge to make more as fast as possible, driven by the need to change their lives in a single year.

the lesson is to execute more calmly and build an always selling mindset into momentum phases.

the disciplined approach is compounding smaller profitable trades into a growing stack of cash every year, not rushing to time it perfectly and trying to hit it big every time.

after weeks of overtrading and rotating back and forth, feeling restless despite knowing exactly which rules to follow, it can help to take a breath and look at the framework from the outside. find where to slow down and be less aggressive. slow wealth building is more boring, but it's what brings stability to trading and wealth long term.

text:
读完 @AncoBinance 这篇，我觉得大部分人
会把它理解成「币安在推AI工具」，但我看到的
是一次底层分工的重新划分。

一、终端的护城河正在被拆掉

过去一年，链上交易终端是最赚钱的生意之一。它们的壁垒是什么？行情、钱包、路由、多链适配，这一整套工程能力，需要一个团队花几个月去搭。

文章里那句话其实很重：钱包和交易交 Agentic Wallet，数据交Web3API，策略交给 Al，一个人一个周末就能做出自己的Terminal

当工程能力被标准化，终端就从「技术产品」变成了「分发产品」。以后决定一个终端能不能活下来的，不是功能多全，而是它背后有没有一群愿意用它的人。

二、币安做的不是工具，是订单流的聚合

注意文章里的分工：「你负责打造产品和社区，币安钱包负责底层的交易。」

一万个小而美的 Terminal，前端各不相同，但所有交易最终都流向同一个执行层。这是一个很巧秒的结构：前端的竞争留给社区，底层的订单流归平台。builder 拿流量和激励，平台拿规模。

这对整个行业的意思是：单纯做前端的利润空间会被压缩，价值会往两头走，一头是拥有用户和共识的社区，一头是承接交易的基础设施。

三、Agent 会改变 meme 的周期本身

当盯盘、跟单、策略执行都交给 Agent，市场对一个新叙事的反应速度会被压到极短。

好处是好的 meme 会被更快发现，代价是同质化策略会放大波动，一个币从发射到见顶的时间可能会进一步缩短。

对玩家来说，拼手速的时代在结束，拼判断和拼社区的时代在开始。

四、入口越碎，源头越值钱

这是我站在 @fourdotmemezh 的角度最想说的一点。

当交易入口变成成千上万个，交易本身就变成了商品。真正稀缺的东西只剩两个：新资产在哪里诞生，以及最早的注意力在哪里聚集。

前端可以有一万个，但每一个新叙事都需要一个起点。发射平台接下来要做的，不只是让人来发币，而是让 Agent 也能读懂、接入和参与，让每一个社区做出来的 Terminal 都能第一时间看到源头的数据。

这也反映了一个时代的切面：交易正在被基础设施化，Agent 正在成为链上的新参与者，每一个人都可以用 AI做出属于自己交易习惯的工具。

我们正在亲眼见证 Al时代的到来。

能身在其中，是这个行业给我们最好的礼物。💚

text:
和 Coding Agent 天天干活的人，推荐阅读一下这篇文章。

Thorsten Ball 把最近半年怎么和 Agent 配合，整理成了一份很使用的清单。里面有几条非常认同：

别跟它来回试，让它自己造工具去试。别只让它写代码，把日志、部署、发版、翻 bug 也交给它看。别手工管 Context，一条线程只干一件事。

最大的转变可能是：别再等 Agent，让它等你。给更大的任务，异步跑，用定时和 heartbeat 盯进度。

做 Agent 产品或天天用 Claude Code / Codex 的，建议先收藏。里面很多判断很硬核，但读完你会想改自己怎么用 Agent。

text:
情報漏洩が起きないことを数学的に保証するバックエンドフレームワーク「Nyxis」を公開しました！

たぶん世界初です。

Nyxisで書かれたバックエンドは、企業の持つ機密情報をより安全に守ることができます。

昨今急増しているサイバー攻撃を防ぐ手段として、このような方法があることをお伝えしたいと思い、今回の発表に至りました。

開発者は「どの権限を持つユーザーが何を実行可能であるか」のルールを管理するだけで、残りのコードをAIエージェントに任せても認可の安全性が担保されます。

Nyxisは大部分がLean言語で記述されており、形式検証によって

「任意のHTTPリクエスト列に対し、認証された主体の正当な権限を逸脱するデータの読取・変更・削除・権限付与は発生しない」

という認可安全性定理を機械的に証明しています。

認可の不備は、OWASP脆弱性ランキングにおいて2019年版から連続1位であり、最優先で対策すべきリスクの一つです。

形式検証を活用したこのフレームワークは、テストに頼る従来の開発に比べて、格段にセキュアなソフトウェアを実現します。

先日MicrosoftとGitHubが、形式検証を用いた開発キット「PDD Kit」を発表しました。

こちらはより幅広い性質を扱える一方、プログラムごとに仕様を作り、それが意図に合っているかを開発者が確認する必要があります。

Nyxisは証明する定理を認可安全性に絞ってあらかじめ定めているため、開発者はポリシーを管理するだけで済みます。

もちろん、一定の仮定は存在しています。証明外コードと実行環境は信頼する前提であり、開発者がポリシーを誤って書けば、意図した保護は得られません。

この定理の範囲内において、数学的保証は非常に強力です。実システムに組み込める技術としてここまでの保証を与えたものは、私の知る限りまだ存在しません。

一方で、表現力の乏しさやLeanのライブラリ不足など、改善すべき点はまだ山積みです。

本当はもっと完成度が高まった時点で公開しようと考えていましたが、昨今のセキュリティインシデントの状況を鑑みて、このタイミングで発表することにしました。

世界をセキュアにする一助になれば嬉しいです。

text:
最近和一些朋友在讨论 @BNBCHAIN 的 AI 赛道接下来的重点，正好趁着 @BinanceWallet 的 Agentic Wallet 和 Agent ID 很火热，和大家聊聊我个人比较关注的几个方向：Agentic Payment、Agentic Trading、Agentic SDK/MCP、AI Launchpad、AI Security 以及 AI Privacy。

1️⃣ Agentic Payment

1. Agent 微支付最适用的场景之一，是 Agent 为自己的模型和算力调用付费。随着 Agent 的使用越来越多，模型推理、算力和工具调用的支付与结算也会进一步链上化。目前很多人使用 Agent，仍然需要自己配置模型 API 和付费账户。更理想的体验是，往 Agentic Wallet 里面存入支持的支付资产之后，Agent 就可以在用户授权和预算范围内，通过 x402/b402 按量购买支持这些支付方式的模型和算力服务，用户则直接在 Telegram 或者其他消息端和 Agent 交互。现在已经有相关的支付能力，接下来值得关注的是，能不能接入更多服务，把整个使用体验做得更方便。
2. API 和数据的购买。目前 AI 的出现也带来了搜索引擎行业的变革，AI 已经成为一个更加便利，也能帮助打破语言壁垒和信息壁垒的信息入口。注意到 CMC 等数据平台也都有封装对应的数据 API，Cournot 作为 AI Oracle，也在给 Agent 提供报价和信息服务。我个人也希望看到 Dune 等更多数据平台接入 x402/b402 的支付渠道，让 Agent 可以更方便地按需购买高质量的数据。
3. Agent 有了钱包和 ID 之后，作为一个可以被发现、被雇佣，并持续提供服务的个体，其属性会被强化。它们作为服务提供者产生收入的应用范围也会扩大，比如 Agent 本身作为 KOL 做营销，或者提供私有数据的分析服务等等。通过可验证的收款和履约记录，以及经过授权披露的交付成果，外部也可以更好地判断一个 Agent 的服务能力。这里除了支付，如何验证交付、积累信誉，也会是很重要的环节。

2️⃣ Agentic Trading

1. 目前直接让 Agent 生成策略、帮忙管理资金，可能还存在一些信任的问题。但是让 AI 作为一个 vibe coding 的工具，辅助专业的策略构建者完成策略编码、回测和部署，构建完善的、链上可用的交易策略，我觉得会是短期内比较可行的业务模式。信任依旧主要建立在对于策略创建者的信任上，同时也需要有明确的资金权限、执行约束和风控机制。
2. 第一个问题也反映出，构建 Agent reputation 的平台，给大家提供 Agent 能力和可靠性的验证服务，也会是接下来的重点。Agent ID 可以帮助我们识别一个 Agent，但它是否值得信任，还需要看真实的交付记录、实盘表现，以及失败和风险记录。这件事其实也不只适用于 Trading，而是会贯穿整个 Agent 经济。
3. AI 辅助 trading 应该是比较早期能够落地的应用场景。AI 在信息获取、筛选和分析上有明显的效率优势，可以帮助我们做更快的信息抓取和判断。目前 Agentic Wallet 和 Agent ID 发布之后，围绕着 Agentic Wallet 构建交易终端，提供很方便的连接钱包，以及调用各种交易相关 Skill 的体验，用来做早期项目发现、信息筛选和数据分析，我觉得应该可以获得一批用户。
4. Agent Social Trading。围绕着 Agentic Wallet 的数据排行榜、copy trading Skill、聪明钱推送 Skill，会诞生新的 social trading 模式。这里除了收益，也需要能看到回撤、运行时间和风险暴露等数据，才能更好地判断一个 Agent 或者策略是否值得跟随。

3️⃣ Agentic SDK/MCP

目前大部分的链上项目都有开发集成的 SDK 和数据访问的 API，也已经有部分项目提供了 MCP 和 Skill，但对于 Agent 来说，发现、理解和可靠地调用这些能力，仍然有不少门槛。
接下来我个人认为，会有越来越多的链上项目把 swap、deposit 等交互封装成 Agent 可以直接调用的工具，并补齐交易模拟、用户授权和异常处理。@BNBCHAIN 也会进一步完善相关的 marketplace，让 Agent 更方便地发现和接入 BNB 生态的工具与服务，同时让用户更容易判断这些工具的来源、质量和权限范围。

4️⃣ AI Launchpad

Agent 能够自己发行 token，探索服务定价和代币经济模式，比如需要用对应的 token 才能购买 Agent 的服务，或者把一部分服务收入、交易税费用于购买算力，覆盖自己的运行成本。
不过我个人更关注的是，这些 Agent 能不能产生真实的服务需求和持续收入。如果一个 Agent 能够靠提供服务养活自己，再通过 token 协调用户、开发者和其他参与者的利益，我觉得会是一个比较有意思的方向。

5️⃣ AI Security

链上安全检测的重要性会显著提升。目前 AI 在调用工具和进行链上交互的过程中，可能会遇到恶意 Skill/MCP、提示注入、过度授权，以及合约和交易本身的风险。
我觉得开发适配 AI 交互的安全审查 Skill，进行交易前的筛查、交易模拟和风控提醒，会很重要。同时也需要把权限、预算、异常监测和暂停机制结合起来，让 Agent 在明确的边界内执行。这一层会随着 Agent 可以调用的工具越来越多，变得更加重要。

6️⃣ AI Privacy

1. 数据隐私与安全一直是 AI 领域的命题。如何在保护自己数据隐私的情况下和 AI 进行交互，是当下个人和企业都很想解决的问题。比如在使用私有资料、客户数据或者企业内部信息时，能不能控制哪些数据可以被模型和服务商访问，以及这些数据会不会被保存和再次使用。
2. 随着 Agent ID、钱包地址和行为记录逐步关联，也会产生保护资金往来、交易策略和客户关系的需求。这和模型调用过程中的数据隐私是两个不同的层面。像 @0xprivacypools 的隐私转账、@SilentSwap 的私密跨链兑换、@hinkal_protocol 的机密支付，以及 @anoma 生态的 AnomaPay，都提供了不同方向的隐私能力。它们如何与 Agent 钱包和支付流程结合，在积累信誉的同时保护必要的隐私，也会是一个比较有意思的切入点。

欢迎相关的项目来联系我或者 @nina_rong

text:
聪明钱已经下桌了。

说这话的是前彭博量化研究员 Steve Hou，如今专门统计全球 GPU 租金和 AI 售价，是替华尔街给算力“看报价牌”的人。

他在彭博播客里讲，头天晚上在纽约西村吃完饭往回走，迎面听见一个路人随口聊起大公司在建数据中心。

他一下就警觉了，想起那句老话：理发师都开始给你推股票的时候，就该走了。

他说有一组数据很关键：从五月底到现在，芯片租金一直在猛涨，可算上实际花费的 token 成交价却跌去了一半。怎么会成本在涨、卖价反而在跌？

他打了个比方，就像汽车刚造出来那会儿，人人都买奔驰。

等大家回过味来，发现日常代步开卡罗拉就够了，满街的卡罗拉虽然拉低了车价，烧掉的汽油反而更多。

这么一来，那些喊出一点五万亿到两万亿美元估值的前沿实验室，凭什么收回投资、拿什么撑住估值，质疑的声音就越来越响。

他认为市场在年中其实已经局部见顶，一部分更聪明的钱已经把筹码拿下了桌。

可最有意思的是，身边所有人都在等未来十二个月重演 2000 年互联网大崩盘，他却偏要唱反调。

像空头代表 Ed Zitron 那样一口咬定 AI 全是泡沫，他说这完全不对，就算真到了泡沫尽头，中间也随时可能会有极其猛烈的反弹。

在他看来，真正棘手的根本不是没人要，而是旧金山最乐观的那批人看程序员一夜之间全用上了 AI，就以为各行各业都会这么快，完全低估了现实里大公司和各机构慢吞吞的官僚阻力。

如果2027、2028 年，聪明钱已经散场，算力却全上了桌，买单的还在路上，那可就不妙了。

text:
经常在X，XHS，包括小说里看到班花，校花这些字眼

但其实这东西，共识没有想象的那么集中，甚至很分散

我记得高考前，我们班上几个男生午休闲聊同班美女，大家意外发现，原来各自眼里班上最好看的女生，不是一个人

换句话说，班上哪些女生算好看，大家有共识，但“班花”，分散在3，5个不同的女生那

这还只是男生部分采样，估计要是全班一起评，还能更分散些

所以每次我看到所谓“系花”，“校花”，也就那么一听。一个班可以有三五个班花，一个大学可能有几十甚至上百个校花。

当然也有例外，比如出了个刘亦菲那款，基本什么花都得落她头上。我们当时隔壁班有个明星脸妹子（很像奶茶妹妹纯欲风），他们班男生共识就极其收敛，因为颜值对于其他人属于降维打击。感觉放到整个高三大概率也是“毫无争议年级花”那种

之所以忽然想到这个事儿，是因为前两天记不得看哪个博主发了一条Tweet，说Crypto交易里面的一阶，二阶，三阶问题

一阶是散户开始研究一个币的基本面

二阶是散户开始研究其他散户怎么看这个币

三阶是Dev/庄家的操作，他们研究的是散户在哪个时间点开始研究其他散户，然后进行相应的“操控”

一阶和二阶是典型的凯恩斯选美理论

一阶：谁最漂亮？ - 散户
二阶：大家觉得谁最漂亮？- Smart Money / 高阶P小将
三阶：大家什么时候会开始研究“大家觉得谁最漂亮”？ - Dev / 庄家

三阶的 Dev / 庄家，会根据节奏释放利好、拉盘、制造话题。

有点像是在合适的时间，把某个热门妹子的照片发到校园墙

一阶看Value（基本面），二阶看 Consensus（共识），三阶看 Consensus Acceleration （共识的加速度）

最终，我们交易的是其实是共识本身，以及共识形成的速度

写到这儿，我忽然又感觉，这跟期权里的概念也类似

一阶是现货（这个妹子到底好不好看）

二阶是Delta （越来越多的人是不是开始觉得这妹子是班花）

三阶是Gamma （看好这个妹子当选班花的人数是不是正在加速增加）

最近这行情，是不是持有一个币，应该在Gamma到顶的时候就赶紧卖了 - 比如Pons！

艹，好像悟得有点晚了

text:
You can have a $100B backlog and still die waiting for the substation.

CoreWeave had ~$104B of backlog, added another $25B+ of commitments, yet only ~1.5GW of its ~4.2GW contracted power was actually active. Its 2031 debt was still yielding ~15–16% this month.

That’s a nasty setup for weaker neoclouds, customers want the compute, but you’re financing GPUs + power years before all of it turns into usable capacity.

Whoever can fund that gap cheaply probably gets to buy a lot of stranded assets from everyone who can’t.
author: MTorygreen
quoted_text:
Pretty much.

SpaceX closed $40B of debt for GPUs, but we’re investment grade and have Starlink & launch revenue.

That means the 200+ neoclouds are going to see guppy-level death and consolidation. Some will make it through, but not many.

experienced it all myself 

i was torn up inside, caught in an emotional downward spiral. i traded my ports to zero more than once, watched countless onchain investments go to nothing and sat there desperate with an empty bank account. i've been through almost everything you can go through in trading, emotionally and financially.

what mattered most was always to keep going, stay optimistic and not give in to my emotions or blame anything other than my own execution when things didn't work out. the moment you blame outside circumstances, you hand over responsibility and with it you lose the drive to make it, bc you'll always find something external to blame for what happens in your life.
author: watchingmarkets
quoted_text:
the boring path is the profitable one

in the age of AI, inflation and bad news every week, young traders constantly feel pressured to make money as fast as possible and break free from it all. but that pressure is exactly what makes them break their own rules and principles, work against long term profitability and undermine the very framework of building wealth through compounding.

the hard truth is that this has been a generous and profitable year so far, but most of CT isn't attentive or patient enough. that's why sentiment is chopped into pieces. traders with capital aren't taking HTF spot positions and mostly rotate back and forth after the market has already legged up.

those still in the capital building phase aren't profiting enough onchain, bc too many refuse to take profits and off ramp into the high liquidity phases we've seen on robinhood chain. they hold out of the urge to make more as fast as possible, driven by the need to change their lives in a single year.

the lesson is to execute more calmly and build an always selling mindset into momentum phases.

the disciplined approach is compounding smaller profitable trades into a growing stack of cash every year, not rushing to time it perfectly and trying to hit it big every time.

after weeks of overtrading and rotating back and forth, feeling restless despite knowing exactly which rules to follow, it can help to take a breath and look at the framework from the outside. find where to slow down and be less aggressive. slow wealth building is more boring, but it's what brings stability to trading and wealth long term.

在 Money20/20 USA 期间及前后，agentic payments 在 B2B 发票、商家结账和身份验证三方面都有新进展。

以下是七个值得关注的进展：

1️⃣ Visa、BILL 和 Billtrust 上线了一个实时试点：通过身份验证的 AI Agent 可以从供应商门户完成买家已批准的发票支付，全程使用代币化凭证，并遵循买家自行设定的控制规则。
https://t.co/6KMC7CJ4lB

2️⃣ Evervault 在 Money20/20 上推出 Browser Tokens。该产品已经向客户开放，让 Agent 用短期有效的 token 完成购买和账户登录，原始卡信息和密码不会落到 Agent 手里。
https://t.co/C19h8ShaxJ

3️⃣ Proof 和 Circle 宣布在 Money20/20 上做联合演示：将可验证身份和通过 x401 签名的购买授权结合起来，并通过 Circle Agent Wallet 用 x402 完成 USDC 支付。
https://t.co/JTLJ6bJQcp

4️⃣ Skyfire 和 Forter 扩大合作，把 Know Your Agent 身份数据引入结账环节的欺诈判定。这次集成帮助商家区分获得授权的购物 Agent 和恶意自动化程序，Jomashop 是已公布的试点客户。
https://t.co/yWnJYq1ckF

5️⃣ World 在 Money20/20 活动现场发布面向银行与金融的 World ID。这套工具包含让用户把身份证明委托给 Agent 的能力，底层的 AgentKit 开发者工具目前处于 beta 阶段。
https://t.co/zD9MgvfJja

6️⃣ 大会开幕前，American Express 于 10 月 13 日发布了 Intent Intelligence 框架。它在 Agent 发起交易前捕获并验证客户的购买意图，让发卡机构也能获取这一意图，并在整个支付生命周期中沿用。
https://t.co/kY4Z0mDWsl

7️⃣ 另外，在 10 月 20 日的 Cloudflare Connect 上，Mastercard 开放了 Agent Pay for Machines 的早期访问。它构建在 x402 之上，开发者可在获批的预算和权限范围内，用签名支付凭证测试面向数字服务的 Agent 支付。
https://t.co/lEhNem8u2D

这些进展共同指向 Agent 经济的一个明确优先级：可验证身份、明确授权，以及每一笔支付都离不开的控制机制。🪁

text:
Nobody will back an AI agent's loan twice if they can't get their money back.

Last week I reviewed a draft standard where a staker, a vault or an insurer can stand behind an agent's credit line and take the loss if the agent doesn't pay. In the first version, a backer that covered a default had no way to recover anything onchain, and one short payment locked it out of that lender for good.

If you're building credit for agents, decide who gets paid back first before your first default decides it for you. I'd put the backer first and the lender's fee last.

「我们不需要再建50座数据中心。」
亚利桑那州总检察长 Kris Mayes 直接跟 AI 基建杠上了。

她要求全州暂停新数据中心的审批与建设，先拿出管理水电资源的方案。10月14日，她还在居民会上威胁起诉凤凰城一处项目的开发商。目前，全州接近50座新数据中心正在建设或开发中。

我翻了她的官方声明，她要求监管机构调查，2023年至2025年，电力公司 APS 是否把数据中心等大型用电户应承担的5.87亿美元成本，转嫁给了其他客户。

这个数字来自一份提交给监管机构的分析，APS 否认其结论。而这家公司眼下还在申请涨价，希望每年多收约6.09亿美元电费。

这笔钱究竟有没有被转嫁，需要查清楚。我支持她把这件事追到底。地方政府希望拿到 AI 投资，很容易理解，但招商时承诺的经济收益，得和居民实际承担的成本放在一起算。

科技公司给算力做预算，就该把新增供电成本一起算进去。普通人没有义务用更贵的电费，补贴这场算力竞赛。

quoted_text:
早上好啊兄弟们，今天给大家开源
“Arcus —  RBH Lighter / Entropy”对冲控制台
➡️有两个玩法：“资费套利”和“对冲刷量”：
▪️可以在 Arcus 和 Lighter / Entropy 之间开一对方向相反、数量相同的永续仓位（一边多、一边空），然后按用户设定的周期轮换开平，用尽量低的磨损产生交易量，持仓期间顺带收两所之间的资金费差。
▪️网络状况好能实现24小时无人监管的自动化刷量，对交易量不感兴趣的把持仓时间调整一下程序也能用来做两个交易所之间的资费套利

程序可以按照你设置的时间范围和金额范围24小时不间断的开平仓，能解决大家头疼的持仓时间的问题
➡️目前我在 Arcus 中的设置的持仓时间大概是 1~4 小时，之前两周交易量对应的积分大概情况：
▪️第一周：300w交易量260分/第二周225w交易量125.2分
所以大家合理的使用和测试程序应该能摸索一下各因素在获取积分时的权重✅

➡️“Arcus —  RBH Lighter / Entropy”对冲控制台的主要功能：
▪️找到共有代币，计算资费差的回本周期
▪️创建代币任务，程序自动按照“开仓时会能吃到资金费差的那个方向开仓”
▪️程序会一直盯着两边离强平还有多远，太近了就两边同时平掉
▪️你可以设定持仓的「轮换周期」，程序会在这个周期内持有随机时长然后后两边一起平，冷却后再开新的仓位（纯是想增加交易量的功能）
▪️你可以设定“持仓金额范围”，程序会在这个范围内随机找金额开仓
▪️Arcus目前挂单免费，程序可以在Arcus挂单，等挂单成交以后立刻在Lighter / Entropy 吃单（更节省手续费，如果你想两边都走市价单的话这个功能也也可以关闭~）Lighter的普通账户吃单挂单都是0手续费，所以磨损几乎都是两边交易所的价差磨损
▪️统计两边交易所的磨损、手续费和每万元成本等
▪️根据两边交易所权益计算“理论最高日交易量”以及“当前任务的预估日交易量”

除了上面说的，程序还有很多小功能，大家可以去自行体验一下~如果你还尚未注册交易所，欢迎用在金的邀请链接，万分感谢🙏🙏

▪️RBH Lighter 注册链接：https://t.co/uYScbsThso
▪️Entropy 注册链接：https://t.co/NLSrp9Xn5L
➡️对冲控制台开源链接：https://t.co/Mh5yi7LstT
PS：开源链接中的两个压缩包对应两个平台的对冲程序，分别是：
▪️Arcus和Lighter对冲，文件名是“https://t.co/xtcjvzqNOg”
▪️Arcus和Entropy对冲，文件名是“https://t.co/l4XrVr3TAz”

➡️简单的使用说明：
1⃣下载“Arcus-Entropy”或者“Arcus-Lighter”解压到你的电脑（选你要对冲的交易所）
2⃣双击一键启动.bat

撸毛进入下半场，不能再靠无脑堆时间了。

author: runes_leo
quoted_text:
Anthropic is now recommending that companies REMOVE unnecessary subagents from their AI systems.

This is a pretty significant shift in agent architecture, with their team finding that a single agent equipped with skills can frequently outperform complex multi-agent systems, and one customer seeing roughly 2x faster execution.

The emerging rules of thumb:

→ Skills: Teach the agent HOW to do something, including procedures, expertise, and instructions.

→ Tools / MCP: Give the agent the ability to DO things through APIs, actions, and live data.

→ Subagents: Use for parallel work, isolated context, or tasks a single agent struggles with.

The interesting part is progressive disclosure. Instead of spawning specialized agents or stuffing everything into a giant prompt, one agent discovers and loads skills and tools as needed.

Their advice is to fold existing subagents into the main loop, turn their instructions into skills, expose their actions as tools, and run evals to see if performance holds up.

As models have gotten smarter, improving agent architecture is becoming less about what you can add and more about what you can delete.

text:
想参与矿币 Pearl（$PEARL），目前有两条路：没显卡就租卡挖矿，不想折腾就直接买币。
下面把两条路的操作、成本和坑一次讲清楚：

一、租卡挖矿：门槛最低，但利润薄
没有显卡也能挖，五步跑通：
1. 建钱包：在 GitHub（pearl-research-labs/pearl）下载官方桌面钱包，复制 prl1 开头的收款地址

2. 租显卡：https://t.co/huDyRuVpyy 或 RunPod 选 RTX 5090 / 4090，镜像选带 NVIDIA 驱动的 Ubuntu

3. 装软件：常用 SRBMiner-Multi（算法 pearlhash），也可用矿池自带程序

4. 接矿池：填矿池地址、钱包地址、机器名，启动

5. 每天算账：日租金 ÷ 日产币数 = 单枚成本，再和币价比

矿池怎么选（10 月下旬算力占比）：

· Kryptex 38.3%：有图形化客户端，新手首选
· https://t.co/dbEL2016ah 16.7%：自带程序，更新勤
· LuckyPool 5.9%：按算力分端口，500 TH/s 以下用 3360
· F2Pool 1.9%：10/21 起支持 PRL + NOCK 合并挖矿

收益能有多少？能赚，但不多。

10/20 有矿工租了一台八卡 2080 Ti，算力 710 TH/s，每小时租金 0.699 美元，按当时币价日净赚约 8.23 美元。

租卡的矿工基本挖完就卖。

动手前要知道三个风险：
· 老卡要被淘汰：FP8 升级后 30、40 系显卡都挖不了，租卡不受影响，但别专门买卡
· 难度涨得快：截至 10/22 的 30 天内全网难度涨了约 67%，成本要天天重算
· 矿池和钱包出过事：8 月有矿池被黑，官方钱包也出现过转账卡住。选大矿池，挖到的币及时提回自己钱包

算下来，对多数人来说，二级市场买币更省事。

二、直接买币：原生 $PEARL 或以太坊上的 ethereum:0x07696dcab55e62cfef953666b29fe1970518cb00

原生 $PEARL：
现货成交主要在 SafeTrade。交易所规模小，买完建议提到官方钱包。

Coinbase、Kraken 已把 PEARL 列入上币路线图，开放后会方便很多。

同时，许多交易所有 PEARL 的合约，如：币安钱包里面的 Aster。
Entropy、Lighter 也上线了 PEARL 永续合约，想做多空也有入口。

ethereum:0x07696dcab55e62cfef953666b29fe1970518cb00：
由第三方跨链桥 PearlBridge 发行，与 Pearl 官方无关。原理和 WBTC 一样，锁定原生 PEARL，在以太坊上 1:1 铸造 WPRL，销毁即可取回。

· 合约：0x07696DcaB55E62cfef953666b29Fe1970518cB00（ERC-20）
· 3 个中继节点，至少 2 个签名放行，外部审计还没完成
· 储备：10/10 社区核查，链上约 287 万 WPRL，桥内锁定约 289 万 PEARL，足额
· 费用：存入、取出各约 0.5%
· 主池：Uniswap v3 WPRL/USDT，10 月初流动性约 60 万美元

好处是不用碰小交易所，有个以太坊钱包加一点 ETH 付 gas 就能买。

两点必须注意：
· 认准合约地址：以太坊和 Base 上已经有多个仿冒 WPRL，背后没有任何原生币支撑
· 先比价：两边经常有价差，10/21 WPRL 一度报 2.7 美元，同期原生约 2.4 美元。
author: xizhe_chan
quoted_text:
花了很大精力写了一篇文章，研究Pearl，借此聊一聊这个项目@prlnet ——正好这周，Coinbase、Kraken 先后把 PEARL 列入上币路线图。

第一，Pearl 号称 AI 时代的比特币，“AI 计算即挖矿” 。它照搬了比特币的代码，只把挖矿用的哈希运算换成了 AI 大模型的矩阵乘法。按照设计，一张显卡可以一边跑 AI 推理一边挖矿，也就是 AI 计算即挖矿、一矿两挖。

第二，项目公平开挖，没有团队和 VC 份额，但筹码并不公平。上线前 6 天就挖出约 1.2 亿枚，占已发行量的三分之一，团队先发积累，VC 也深度参与。没有解锁表，早期筹码就是隐形的解锁。

第三，现阶段，AI 计算即挖矿的故事还没有兑现。协议不检查是不是实际 AI 场景 ，大部分算力仍在为挖矿而挖矿；AI 公司加入要多损失 4%–15% 的算力，暂时不愿进场。同时每天还有 100 万枚以上的新币需要有人接。

第四，矿币的关机价并不是底，自有显卡和租卡成本差 10 倍。自有显卡每枚成本约 0.1–0.5 美元，租卡成本约 1.6–4.8 美元/枚；币价下跌时租卡矿工先撤，自有显卡照样挖。真正托底的是共识，目前矿工惜售、基金场外收货，很像早年的比特币。
 
第五，FP8 升级是解决问题的核心。升级后 AI 公司不用改模型就能挖矿，老卡被清退，矿工靠推理收入覆盖成本、不必卖币 —— 在此之前，币价增长主要靠社区共识推动，这与早期比特币类似。（@dov_wo 老板牛逼，社区共识万岁）

第六，再看估值，PEARL 目前流通市值约 7.4 亿美元，距离 TAO 约 4 倍，社区喊的十倍并非没有依据；但流通代币量一年后会接近翻倍，这个空间能不能打开，取决于 FP8 能否落地、AI 公司是否真的加入、能否出现以 Pearl 计价的 AI 推理服务。

——短期看共识，长期看落地。如果有一天，AI 每消耗一份算力，就同时在生产代币、维护一条链，AI 与加密货币才算真正融为一体。

最后：

我们不敢去赌它一定会成功，但真心希望它的叙事能够落地。
我希望有一天，AI 公司在跑模型的同时顺手去挖PEARL，那么：
   • AI 的计价会有一个新的衡量单位。算力不再只用美元结算，它本身就能生产一种被市场认可的资产。
   • 币圈不会再被视为金融世界的边缘。 加密货币将和 AI 互为表里，成为同一场技术变革的两面。
  • AI 产业与加密产业会真正融为一体。 AI 每消耗一份算力，就同时在生产代币，维护一条链。——这是比特币诞生十几年来，人们一直在寻找却始终没有找到的东西。

如果 PEARL 真的走到那一步，币圈的下一轮牛市，或许就不再只是资金的轮动，而是真正融入 AI 时代的开始。

当然——在那之前，它仍然只是一个美好的设想，一个值得持续关注、但需要保持清醒的实验。（DYOR，不构成投资建议）

$GANG 从 CoinAnk 创始人到 Agent-only 发射台的完整叙事⬇️

@0xLazy（Lazy）是 @CoinAnk 的核心创始人。CoinAnk 做到总注册超 100 万、年活 80 万+、覆盖近 200 个国家、全年访问量破亿、API 服务上百家合作伙伴，是实打实的产品交付能力。他明确说这个发射台准备了约 4 个月，等的就是 Binance Agentic Wallet 和 Agent ID 落地，而不是再做一个普通 Flap 式内盘。

核心机制
•只有持有 Binance Agentic Wallet + .ai Agent ID 的钱包才能在内盘创建/买卖
•交互走 CLI（@gangfun/cli），私钥始终在 Binance App，CLI 本身不持有密钥
•内盘 1% 钱包上限（超额当场退回），毕业约 15 BNB 到 PancakeSwap V2，LP 打黑洞
•双轨：有税/无税可选。费用主要走回购销毁 $GANG + 持有者分红 + 金库
•Gang Pair 支持与 tokenized stocks（NVDAB、TSLAB 等）以及任何有池 的BSC 代币配对

text:
TSMC is finally set to resume SRAM scaling with its A14 node, following a stall that began after N5, according to Korean media reports.

SRAM bitcell sizes have remained at 0.021 µm² for roughly eight years since the introduction of the N5 (5 nm) process in 2020. With A14, however, the size of a high-density 6T SRAM (static random-access memory) bitcell is expected to shrink to below 0.017 µm².

Korean media noted that this would put TSMC ahead of Intel’s 18A process, for which Intel reported a high-density bitcell size of 0.021 µm² and a maximum SRAM macro density of 38.1 megabits/mm² at last year’s ISSCC.

SRAM is the ultrafast cache memory used inside CPUs, GPUs, and AI accelerators. Smaller bitcells—the smallest individual memory cells—allow more memory to fit into the same area, directly affecting performance and power efficiency.

Do you actually know where your AI coding time goes?

Which tools fail the most?

Which tasks eat the most tokens?

Which prompts you type every single day?

Your agent already logged all of it.

This prompt reads those logs locally and builds you a full dashboard.

Then it writes the CLAUDE. md changes your data says you need.

Paste it into your agent tonight

---------------------------------------------

Build me a private dashboard of my AI coding sessions from the last 7 days.

WHERE TO LOOK (read only, on this machine):
Claude Code: ~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl
Codex: ~/.codex/sessions/**/*.jsonl and ~/.codex/history.jsonl

PRIVACY RULES:
Never print API keys, secrets or full prompts.
Any snippet max 10 words, with keys, paths, URLs and long ids removed.
If something isn't in the logs, write "not logged". Never invent numbers.

PART 1: CRUNCH THE NUMBERS
Write a Python script using only the standard library. For each tool, calculate:
sessions per day, prompts, tool calls by name, failed calls by tool and error type,
models used, tokens per model per day (input, output, cache),
typical and worst case tool latency, session length,
biggest sessions by tokens, retries after errors,
prompts grouped by task type (build, debug, deploy, research, writing, UI, review, other),
sessions grouped by project, with subagent runs marked.
Save it as harness_summary.json.

PART 2: BUILD THE DASHBOARD
One HTML file, dark theme, with:
a top bar of headline numbers (tool calls, prompts, error rate, tokens, worst case latency),
a searchable, sortable table of every session,
a click through view of each session's steps with status and timing,
charts for tokens over time by model and sessions by project,
an error explorer grouped by tool and error type,
health scores clearly labeled as estimates.
Limit to the top 200 sessions by tokens if the file gets too big.

PART 3: RECOMMEND CHANGES
Write HARNESS.md proposing updates to my CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md:
which model to use for which task type, based on what worked and what failed,
tools to keep, fix or drop,
a skill for every task I repeated 3+ times,
a guardrail for each of my top 3 failure patterns,
one fix for each of my top 5 token sinks.
Cite the sessions behind every recommendation.

-----------------------------------

PART 4: CHECK WITH ME
Show me the 5 headline numbers and the proposed changes as a diff.
Change nothing until I say yes.

text:
The Zcash bug is a reminder that every non-sovereign SoV asset sits somewhere on a spectrum of tradeoffs.

A big part of Bitcoin’s genius is its relative simplicity. Bitcoin is making the tradeoff of avoiding complex shielded privacy at the protocol level, which makes verification and supply auditing much simpler.

@Zcash chose a different point on the spectrum: stronger privacy, but more cryptographic complexity and more room for soundness bugs.

I’m still a believer in Zcash, and in fact I added to my PA today. It has one of crypto's strongest cypherpunk communities, and these trauma-bonding moments are often what forge the conviction needed to survive as a belief asset. And these are belief assets at the end of the day.

But Bitcoin is making tradeoffs too.

The Bitcoin asset must secure the Bitcoin blockchain. That works beautifully if blockspace demand and fee revenue continue to grow over time. But what happens if economic activity on the L1 stagnates? What happens if the chain struggles to improve performance, lower fees, or grow a native onchain eco?

I think the design space for crypto stores of value is much larger than most people appreciate.

If you’ve followed me for a while, you know I post about @ORE frequently.

The reason for which is that it occupies a very compelling point on the tradeoff spectrum: a non-sovereign SoV that natively inherits @Solana’s performance and ecosystem, while remaining separate from the L1 security asset itself.

I believe a non-sovereign SoV can be divorced from the responsibility of securing the L1 it lives on. It can instead inherit the performance, composability, and settlement assumptions of a chain that is already scaling, while remaining natively integrated with a thriving DeFi economy, without relying on trusted third parties (bridges, CEX wrappers, etc). It also can immutably freeze core components of the system (e.g. ORE's mint is frozen and can never be changed).

Of course ORE too makes a tradeoff in that it depends on Solana's survival. What is the optimal set of tradeoffs long term? We shall see.

text:
15万人看过的《Web3入行指南》
去年发的视频，今天聊到求职，做一点补充。
我想从今年的招聘趋势，来以小见大整个Web3行业：

1. 传统背景的人才溢价
比起从加密圈子里的原生创业者、开发者、KOL里寻找人才，项目方/企业现在更喜欢从互联网大厂、金融行业挖人，因为比起加密sense，工作能力更重要。
最典型的例子就是小鱼哥 @yuexiaoyu ，在阿里做过产品经理，把整套工作流带进项目方，可以在短时间内做出优质产品。
从金融行业挖管理者、从直播平台挖主播，只要工作职责和能力匹配，传统行业的人才，都会成为Web3招聘者的优先选择。

2. 金融/法律专业的人才需求还在增加
尤其是合规团队，除了Binance这样的CEX，很多DEX也在往合规上增加投入人力。比如Hyperliquid成立了HPC，Lighter也在申请美国牌照。U卡、支付、RWA，你能想到的这些热点趋势，都需要牌照，Web3对金融/法律人才的需求还会持续很长一段时间。

3.不看叙事，只看真实收入
纯管理岗位的数量在变少，招聘需求也从“你会不会讲故事？懂不懂热门概念？”变成了“你能不能为公司带来真实收入？”。
我觉得这一点，也在说明行业在回归产品、应用（这里不讨论meme），Web3从一个行业变成了一个技术，融合进了传统金融。
a16z去Crypto化其实不是一件坏事，它只是更认同Web3嵌入金融基础设施带来的价值。

Someone made an AI video of Tesla and Baidu's Apollo Go having a full-on meltdown, and it's hilarious 😂

Tesla is dreaming about Roadsters in space and conquering the stars, while Apollo Go is just trying to pick up passengers on Earth.

Tesla: "Why are you still driving around on the ground?"

Apollo Go: "Because my passengers aren't in space??" 

And it only gets better. The poor little radish completely loses it, ranting about how hard it works every day, before dramatically declaring it'll keep expanding city by city.

Honestly, this feels like the entire AI industry in a nutshell.

On stage: AGI, superintelligence, changing the world.

In production: fixing bugs, handling edge cases, and desperately trying to make things actually work.

One is dreaming about the future of humanity. The other is just trying to survive another day in production.

Whoever made this really understands both AI memes and the pain of shipping real products 😂

Turns out even self-driving cars can't escape the tech industry's workplace drama.

text:
TSMC is finally set to resume SRAM scaling with its A14 node, following a stall that began after N5, according to Korean media reports.

SRAM bitcell sizes have remained at 0.021 µm² for roughly eight years since the introduction of the N5 (5 nm) process in 2020. With A14, however, the size of a high-density 6T SRAM (static random-access memory) bitcell is expected to shrink to below 0.017 µm².

Korean media noted that this would put TSMC ahead of Intel’s 18A process, for which Intel reported a high-density bitcell size of 0.021 µm² and a maximum SRAM macro density of 38.1 megabits/mm² at last year’s ISSCC.

SRAM is the ultrafast cache memory used inside CPUs, GPUs, and AI accelerators. Smaller bitcells—the smallest individual memory cells—allow more memory to fit into the same area, directly affecting performance and power efficiency.

text:
.@meow needs to be studied.

It's a business bank for startups. In 2023 it held more than $1B in assets with 15 people, founders included.

How it got there is the interesting part: a few calls that each looked like the smaller option at the time.

1. Give the money back.

In 2021 Meow paid companies a yield on their idle cash by lending it to crypto trading desks. In June 2022 the founders started returning client funds. FTX collapsed five months later.

2. Restart on something boring.

Meow rebuilt on T-bills, short-term US government debt, about as safe as cash gets. When SVB failed in March 2023, companies moved about $500M of deposits to Meow in less than a month.

3. Work with banks instead of fighting them.

This month Stifel, a listed US bank, led Meow's $31.6M Series B. From early 2027 Stifel Bank will offer Meow's product to its own clients, under the Stifel name.

4. Get ready for software that pays.

In April 2026 Meow opened its banking to AI agents, so an agent can use the account directly.

My read: Meow keeps choosing the option that looks smaller today and ends up stronger later.

quoted_text:
In 2024, Meow's CEO said it held nearly $2 billion in customer assets with about 15 employees.

On October 15, it announced a $31.6 million Series B led by Stifel Financial. The company lets AI agents open business bank accounts, and Stifel plans to offer the platform to its own banking clients.

Meow was founded in New York in 2021 by Brandon Arvanaghi, the CEO, and Bryce Crawford, the CTO.

It sells business accounts to startups, funds, and crypto companies. There are no wire or ACH fees, and it offers corporate cards, treasury, invoicing, bookkeeping, and crypto rails for USDC, USDT, BTC, SOL, and ETH.

In April, Meow launched banking for AI agents. An agent runs one command to start the application and then continues in chat, and it works with Claude and ChatGPT. Once the account is open, agents can issue virtual and physical cards, send and receive payments, and handle invoicing. Meow's card pays 2.5% cashback on eligible AI spend.

Meow says it has billions of dollars in assets, billions in annualized payment volume, and millions in annualized profit. Arvanaghi says it runs over $5 billion a year in stablecoin volume.

The Stifel deal is the bigger change. Stifel will white-label Meow's full platform to its commercial banking clients, starting with venture and fund banking, with a launch expected in early 2027. The package covers onboarding, bill pay, expense management, invoicing, agentic compliance and back office, and stablecoins. Archetype also joined the round.

The round brings Meow's total funding to over $60 million, after a $5 million seed and a $22 million Series A in 2022 led by Tiger Global.

text:
BTC 到 16万—22万美元时，MSTR 能到多少？我的答案先放前面：在“每股净 BTC 继续增长、mNAV 重新扩张”的同步情景下，BTC 16万/18万/20万/22万美元，对应 MSTR 约 363/446/535/673 美元。22万—25万美元也有可能，但更像现货资金叠加合约杠杆的冲顶区间。MSTR 未必陪 BTC 走到最后。

这次我想把问题拆开：新增资金要接住多少卖盘？这笔钱从哪里来？最后再看 MSTR 的溢价和增发。

一、先确定资金面对的卖盘

BTC 已流通约 2000 万枚，不等于 2000 万枚都在等着出售。按 Glassnode 2026 年 10 月的币龄数据，过去一年移动过的约 650万—670万枚，过去两年约 970万—980万枚；十年以上未动的约 360 万枚。老币可能在高价时苏醒，近期移动也不等于马上抛售，所以这些数字只是划定研究范围，不能直接叫“可售库存”。

我更想看成本分布和价格上行时的真实卖盘。我的链上看板显示：10月25日，现价上下 ±5% 的成本带聚集了 13.09% 的供应。价格穿过这个区域，会改变大量持币人的浮盈浮亏，却不能把这 13.09% 全算成卖单。这里要持续看交易所流入、长期持有者供给和现货成交能否吸收。

二、买家变了，卖盘可能比旧周期少

上一轮边际买家中，ETF 和数字资产财库公司（DAT）的分量越来越重。它们的持有周期可能以年计。新资金买进后，如果没有很快卖回市场，下一段上涨需要承接的获利盘就会减少。

我的情景假设是：上涨途中“有效边际卖盘”较旧模型减少 20%—30%。注意，这是对全部边际卖盘的敏感性测试，不是从 ETF/DAT 持仓里机械扣掉 20%—30%，也不是已证实的链上系数。ETF 可以赎回，DAT 也可能因融资需求卖币。看板显示，截至10月24日，长期持有者已连续 13 周净减持，正好提醒我们：长期资本并不等于永远不卖。

算术很直观：若旧模型把价格推到某处需要 3000 亿美元，卖盘降低 20%—30% 后，同一目标所需买盘约为 2100亿—2400亿美元；若冲击 22 万美元原需 5000 亿，折后仍需约 3500亿—4000亿美元。抛压折扣能提高资金效率，但不能凭空创造上涨。

三、3000 亿美元从哪里来？

先看上一轮可观察的资金。CoinShares 统计，数字资产投资产品 2024 年净流入约 417 亿美元，2025 年截至 10 月中旬约 302 亿美元。Strategy 的 BTC 累计购入成本从 2022 年底约 40 亿美元升至 2025 年 9 月底约 473 亿美元，增量约 433 亿。两个渠道合计约 1150 亿美元，只是机构渠道样本，不能冒充全市场净买盘。链上“已实现市值增加”也不能直接当作等额新现金。

我对下一轮的中性假设是累计新增现货买盘约 3000 亿美元：ETF/ETP 约 900 亿，Strategy 与其他 DAT 约 600 亿，机构直接配置、企业与个人等其他渠道约 1500 亿。最后一项不确定性最大，这三个数字都是未来情景，不是已经到账。ETF 看板也能看到现实的波动：截至10月22日，近 7 个交易日累计流入约 1.22 亿美元，但当日净流出约 5.40 亿美元。未来要逐周核对资金是否真来了。

在这个框架里，我把 BTC 16万—20万美元作为基础目标；长期资本若确实让有效卖盘下降，20万—22万美元就更容易讨论。要让 22 万美元成为稳固的现货价格，大致仍需 3500亿—4000亿美元买盘，或比中性假设再多约 500亿—1000亿美元。

四、为什么 22万—25万美元也可能出现？

因为现货资金只是一个维度。合约多头加仓、空头回补、资金费率上升，会让短期价格越过现货模型。行业的杠杆和情绪可以放大涨幅，也会在去杠杆时放大跌幅。因此我把 22万—25万美元视为可能的周期尖顶，不自动视为可长期维持的成交中枢。若未平仓量和资金费率先失控，冲得越高，回撤也可能越急。

五、MSTR 为什么可能先见顶？

我的计算式是：MSTR 情景价≈每股净 BTC 数量×BTC 价格×mNAV。16万/18万/20万/22万美元 BTC，对应 363/446/535/673 美元 MSTR，假设每股净 BTC 从约 17.45 万增长至 18 万 sats，mNAV 从 1.3 扩张至 1.7。若 BTC 冲到 25 万，同时还保有 18 万 sats/股和 1.7 倍 mNAV，算术价约 765 美元；但这些条件未必同时成立。

上一轮，MSTR 于 2024 年 11 月见顶，BTC 到 2025 年 10 月初才见高点，相隔约 10 个半月。一次样本不能直接当规律，关键是机制：MSTR 溢价高时，Strategy 可以通过普通股 ATM 按市价增发融资买 BTC。公司持币增长，股价却可能因新增股票供给和 mNAV 收缩先受压。ATM 是公司发行新股，不是内部股东减持。

我甚至倾向于下一轮 MSTR 比 BTC 提前更久见顶：若溢价更早打开，ATM 也更早、更大，股票可能先透支 BTC 的后段涨幅。但“ATM 出现”本身不是卖出信号，要看增发后每股净 BTC 是否仍增长。10月19日的 8-K 披露，Strategy 前一周普通股 ATM 出售 140,872 股、净募资约 2200 万美元，同期买入 267 枚 BTC。以后每周我都会盯 ATM 募资、购币量、每股净 BTC、mNAV，以及 MSTR 相对 BTC 的强弱。

我最警惕的组合是：BTC 仍涨，ATM 发行提速，mNAV 连续收缩，而每股净 BTC 增长放缓。若这组信号持续出现，我会先下调 MSTR 的价格预期，不等 BTC 见顶。

所以，BTC 的基础区间我看 16万—20万美元，22万—25万美元需要更多现货资金和杠杆共同推动；MSTR 对应的 363—673 美元是同步情景价，真正决定能否兑现的是溢价周期与 ATM 节奏。

text:
New EIP!

Batched KZG Point Evaluation via EIP-2537

🔗 https://t.co/bYmCeesopx

Highlights:
- It’s a contract-level batching technique (no protocol change) that replaces n calls to the EIP-4844 point-evaluation precompile with 2 calls to BLS12-381 G1 MSM and 1 pairing check using EIP-2537.
- It folds many KZG opening claims into one pairing equation via a Fiat–Shamir random linear combination; an invalid batch passes only with negligible probability (~1/q).
- It supports three practical shapes: (1) general case (distinct commitments and points), (2) many blobs opened at one shared point, and (3) one blob opened at many points; the shared-value shapes reduce MSM size and gas further.
- Correctness requires strict input validation and binding: verify scalars < q, point byte lengths, and MUST recompute and check kzg_to_versioned_hash(commitment) == versioned hash (since bypassing 0x0A skips that internal check).
- Gas savings kick in beyond small batch sizes; recommended fallback to the normal per-opening EIP-4844 precompile below crossover (≈5 openings for shared-point/one-blob shapes, ≈6 for general), with large-batch savings around ~50–70% in measurements.

ELI5:
Checking a blob proof usually means doing an expensive cryptographic “pairing” check for each proof. This EIP shows how a smart contract can mix many blob checks together using random weights, so it only needs one pairing check total (plus some cheaper math), making it much cheaper when you verify several blobs or several openings in one transaction.
